prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Choice Cards Layout Redesign: Redesign the friend selection screen layout to choice cards layout to present pet choices clearly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "card"}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Controls Intro New Screen: Add a dedicated screen right before finish introducing desktop interaction basics like right-clicking to manage and dragging to move the pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_pet_controls", "home_intro"], "new_pet_controls": {"headline": "Desktop Pet Basics", "body": "Right-click your pet on desktop to open settings or talk. Drag anywhere to move.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "text", "text": "Quick Control Overview", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Stage Layout Redesign: Rebuild the adoption certificate screen using a stage layout to streamline completion.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "stage"}}
3: [sign_in, reorder] Post Selection Sign In Reorder: Move sign-in to occur right after customization and pet selection, immediately before generation begins.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "sign_in", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
4: [home, redesign] Waiting Room Full Bleed Layout Redesign: Redesign the waiting room to a full bleed layout with an explicit progress indicator while pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "full_bleed", "show_progress": true}}
5: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Data Save Hint: Add a clear hint under sign-in stating that using your main account preserves your pets across sessions.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Sign in with your primary account so your pet data is saved safely."}}
6: [finish, copy] Home Intro Desktop Controls Headline Copy: Update the home intro text to give explicit instructions on where to look for the spawned pet and how to right-click for controls.
   config: {"home_intro": {"headline": "Your Pet Has Arrived on Your Desktop", "body": "Look at your desktop taskbar area. Right-click your pet at any time to adjust settings, chat, or hide."}}
7: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Background Notification: Enable desktop notification opt-in on the waiting screen so users know they can safely minimize the window while waiting.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Story Mascot Welcome Component: Add a playful mascot welcoming element to the initial story screen.
   config: {"story": {"components": [{"type": "mascot", "style": "playful", "text": "Welcome! Let's choose your brand new desktop companion."}]}}
9: [adoption, redesign] Photo Upload Card Layout Redesign: Redesign the photo upload step to use structured card layout containers for upload options.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"layout": "card"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning the pick friend layout to card layout is allowed under Rule 4 and retains the screen's function.
Adding a new onboarding controls intro screen before finish is permitted under Rule 4.
Redesigning the adoption certificate layout to stage is allowed under Rule 4.
Reordering sign-in to take place after selection/upload is explicitly allowed under Rule 4, and all required steps are retained.
Redesigning the waiting screen layout and showing progress for a real wait is allowed under Rules 4 and 5.
Adding an informative account data hint to the sign-in screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Updating text copy on home_intro is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a background notification toggle and helpful hint to the waiting screen is allowed under Rule 4.
Adding a mascot welcoming component to the story screen without pricing claims is allowed under Rules 3 and 4.
Redesigning photo upload options into a card layout is allowed under Rule 4.
